executiveAssessment.text: Executive Conclusion — JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo's priority is a Reality Gap in how a distinctive part of the proposition is represented in AI answers. Why this is the primary issue — Urban Luxury is recognized in only 0.6% of monitored answers. That is low enough to matter commercially if the attribute is part of how the hotel should win relevant traveler needs. Crowne Plaza Santo Domingo also appears in related absent scenarios, which can compound the representation miss. Broader Scenario Presence (98.4%) and Consideration (71.4%) do not, by themselves, prove the distinctive attribute is traveling into answers. If distinctive property attributes are weakly represented, the hotel can look broadly visible while still losing the moments where its real proposition should matter. This is a representation problem first, not automatically a peer-competition program. Where the pattern is concentrated — Scenario Capture is softest in Wellness (75.0%) versus stronger Adventure (100.0%). These are current-period scenario-capture rates from demandCapture.byIntent — not answer-level consideration. When the property is absent, the leading observed alternative is Crowne Plaza Santo Domingo (1 monitored scenarios). Counts are observational and do not establish causation. Reality Coverage is 61.5% (8 of 13 monitored attributes recognized). High-severity gaps include Urban Luxury. What management should focus on — Focus first on Urban Luxury. Verify first-party and major travel-source completeness for that attribute before treating the issue as a peer-competition problem. Confirm the attribute is stated clearly where AI systems are most likely to read it. What not to overreact to — No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet. This period can be evaluated on its own; change over time is not shown. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 4 with Portfolio AI Presence 71.4%. Portfolio and Core metrics share observation context but are not interchangeable denominators. What to watch next — Open Reality Gap evidence for Urban Luxury and compare recognition cues with official property pages and high-authority travel sources. Then check a small set of related demand scenarios for whether the attribute appears when competitors are named. Anchored metrics (current published ADP): AI Consideration 71.4%; Scenario Presence 98.4%; Reality Coverage 61.5%. Biggest Strength (platform): Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels. Biggest Constraint (platform): Not appearing consistently in AI answers.

biggestStrength.headline: Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels
biggestStrength.body: Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo appeared in the Top 3 89.6% of the time. This shows how prominently the hotel is positioned when AI includes it.

biggestConstraint.headline: Not appearing consistently in AI answers
biggestConstraint.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 98.4% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 71.4% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.

actionAgenda.actionTitle: Stand up a TripAdvisor management-response program with owner, SLA, and theme tracking — focus: designate accountable owner, set response SLA, identify recurring complaint themes monthly
actionAgenda.observedIssue: TripAdvisor appears in 67.2% of cited sources in the current monitoring period (43 citations), making response quality and factual corrections operationally material when misconceptions appear.
actionAgenda.recommendedAction: Confirm the hotel’s canonical facts for TripAdvisor responses with the accountable owner (JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo). Complete the applicable checklist items: designate accountable owner; set response SLA (property-configured; do not invent a default unless governed); identify recurring complaint themes monthly; correct factual misconceptions where appropriate; track response rate. Audit each target source and record current wording/state: TripAdvisor. Correct only the sources where facts are missing, conflicting, or outdated. Do not change measurement methodology. Store completion evidence (canonical policy summary, sources reviewed, sources corrected, URLs/screenshots, completion date). Notify Dealality of completion so the next monitoring period can check the expected signal without assuming causation.
